title: Lunar Prospector Neutron Spectrometer Data
description: Thermal and epithermal neutron counting rate maps derived from the Lunar Prospector Neutron Spectrometer (January 1998 - July 1999). Both products are sensitive to hydrogen (water ice) presence; epithermal suppression is a direct hydrogen proxy, thermal suppression is sensitive to hydrogen and other neutron absorbers (Fe, Ti, Gd, Sm). Map bin size 60 km × 60 km. Special products prepared by the LP Spectrometer Team, LANL. Source: PDS Geosciences Node, November 2000.
